title: Identify a conditional EUR RAM text-buffer writer
changes: Identify a live-RAM-field writer of the text-substitution callback buffer, preserving the conditional nature of the path.
validation: Wine e158-byte00-ram-forward-dis-wine-ds4kthpq shows the caller passing 02001f1c as destination and 0812e464 copying trimmed live context+312 content through stack scratch with CpuSet.
limitations: The live field producer, legal contents, invocation order, callback reachability and ordinary byte00 use remain unproved; Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurement.
